market_note: A true 5-bedroom / 3+ bath purchase under $2M within 25 minutes of Nancy's is extremely scarce right now. Island-wide 5BR inventory exists (Zillow showed ~32 results) but the usable down-island stock is mostly $2.4M–$3.0M (Hidden Cove, Eastville, in-town Vineyard Haven) or $4M–$13M waterfront/historic estates that are over the family's ceiling. As of 18 Aug 2026 the only clearly in-budget 5BR/3+BA actives we verified in range are 39 Ferro Way ($1.488M, 2020 ADU layout, 6BR septic) and 10 Danls Way ($1.70M farmhouse + cottage, now contingent). Construction on-island is expensive (often $700–$1,000+/sf plus permitting), so land+build is not automatically cheaper than buying, but it is more realistic if the goal is a 5–6 bedroom family compound with pool: Oak Bluffs 6BR-approved lots at $975k–$1.90M and West Tisbury 3-acre 6BR-septic parcels at $1.20M–$1.58M are actually on the market. Expect 12–24+ months of MVC/BOH/building process. Chilmark/Aquinnah were skipped as too far; no invented listings.

listings.beach_access: public beach noted; ~0.7 mi to Owen Park, ~0.6 mi to Lake Tashmoo landing
listings.notes: Best in-budget 5BR/4BA we found. 2020 build with a permitted walkout ADU, first-floor primary, and a 6-bedroom septic already in place so a detached guest house is a real path. Lot is only 0.36 acres so a pool is tight but the ADU already splits two family units. Tashmoo Watershed / NitROE system is a due-diligence item.

listings.beach_access: association / private beach access noted on listing
listings.notes: Rare under-$2M compound: 4BR 1850 farmhouse plus detached 1BR guest cottage on 1.27 acres of lawn near Alley's. Sleeps as 5BR/3BA with separate guest unit for another family. Tea Lane flags a contingent offer as of 18 Aug 2026 — backup only unless it falls through. Room to garden and entertain; not a pool listing.

listings.beach_access: association beach; 0.3 mi to Sengekontacket Pond, community dock/kayak racks, access toward State Beach
listings.notes: Turn-key 4BR main house plus detached studio/loft with full bath (MLS counts 5BR) on 1.5 acres in Hidden Cove. Association tennis, pickleball, dock and pond access are a strong summer-use match. Over budget at $2.4M; Compass had shown under-contract earlier but Viewpoints still lists Active on 18 Aug 2026 — confirm status with the listing agent.

listings.beach_access: steps to Eastville Beach / public beach; two parcels from shoreline
listings.notes: Closest 6BR/4BA to Nancy's: renovated 1859 Greek Revival with two first-floor ensuites, four upstairs bedrooms, rooftop deck, and Land Bank parcels on two sides. Sleeps a multi-unit family plus guests. Over budget; marketed with rental history (purchase-only search still fits). Compass $2.118M figure looks stale vs Elliman/Island RE/Anchor at $2.60M (price drop 15 Jul 2026).

listings.beach_access: across the street from Owen Park Beach / town dock
listings.notes: Updated 1808 Cape directly across from Owen Park: 5BR/4BA, two ensuites, harbor views, walk-to-town. Lot is only 0.20 acres so no pool/compound expansion. Reduced 14 Aug 2026 from $2.95M to $2.695M. Strong location, weaker as a 4-family compound.
listings.source: Wallace & Co. Sotheby's via Tea Lane

listings.beach_access: leisurely stroll to Owen Park town beach; public beach noted
listings.notes: Restored 1842 Greek Revival in the William Street Historic District, 1 block from Main Street and 2 from the ferry. 5BR/4BA with two first-floor bedrooms. Tiny 0.16-acre lot — no extension/pool. Over budget; better as a walkable in-town house than a family compound.

listings.beach_access: none noted; Lagoon Heights neighborhood, short drive to Lagoon/harbor beaches
listings.notes: Why expandable: 4BR main house plus a full 1BR guest apartment over the garage (separate kitchen/laundry) already functions as 5 sleeping rooms, on 1.38 acres in R3 with listing language that the lot is large enough for an in-ground pool (seller may escrow $50k toward a pool). 2026 gut renovation. Over budget but one of the better compound-shaped houses in Oak Bluffs.

listings.beach_access: Lambert's Cove Beach (town/resident) nearby; listing notes ocean/public beach ownership
listings.notes: Why expandable: 2BR main house + 2BR guest studio already split two dwellings, gunite pool on 2.9 acres, and the listing states future expansion to 12 bedrooms is possible with a septic upgrade. Slightly over $2M. Strongest pool+compound existing-home match in range; new listing (~1 day on market as of fetch).

listings.beach_access: Hidden Cove association: direct Sengekontacket Pond access, tennis; public beach noted
listings.notes: Why expandable: 4BR/3BA plus a 512-sf finished lower level not counted in sqft (media/gym/office — possible 5th sleeping room if septic allows). Under $2M with pond/tennis amenities, but the 0.29-acre lot is too small for a real extension or pool. Honest fit: location/amenities yes, multi-family compound no.

listings.beach_access: none noted; Oak Bluffs interior, short drive to State Beach / Sengekontacket
listings.notes: Most affordable 6-bedroom-septic lot we verified in Oak Bluffs. Approved 6BR septic plans, topo/survey/soils in hand; listing says main house + guest house possible with combined 6-bedroom cap. Best land path for a family compound near Nancy's if the family will wait out permitting/build.

listings.beach_access: minutes to Oak Bluffs beaches; conservation trails from The Preserve
listings.notes: Last homesite in The Preserve at The Woodlands. 1.87 acres, underground utilities, town water, BOH approval for 6 bedrooms. HOA ~$2,500. Premium Oak Bluffs land for a custom 5–6BR compound; land alone is already near the $2M cap before vertical construction.

listings.beach_access: none noted; minutes to West Tisbury village / south-shore beaches by car
listings.notes: 3.42-acre pastoral parcel off Rogers Path marketed specifically as a custom Vineyard compound (main house, guest house, accessory structures with permitting). Building envelope already set. Lowest-priced larger lot in range; septic bedroom count not stated — confirm BOH before assuming 5–6BR.

listings.beach_access: public beach noted; Vineyard Sound views; Lambert's Cove area
listings.notes: Ridge-top 3.01 acres with 1.41-acre building envelope, 6BR septic design approved, 12 gpm well in, NHESP cleared, CGI of a house + infinity pool. Strong custom-compound canvas. Drive time from Nancy's is near the 25-minute edge (Lambert's Cove / Fire Tower). Appointment-only; access crosses abutting land.

listings.beach_access: minutes to Lambert's Cove Beach; public beach noted on MLS
listings.notes: 3.32-acre hilltop with Site Plan Review and 6BR septic approvals in hand, well and power on site, and Sullivan & Associates plans for a 4BR/4.5BA house + garage (septic would allow more bedrooms). Reduced from $1.645M to $1.575M. Compound possible; ~22 min estimate from Oak Bluffs harbor.

listings.beach_access: none noted; <1 mile to Edgartown center / short drive to South Beach
listings.notes: Last lot in a 5-lot Edgartown subdivision. Town water AND town sewer, 7-bedroom capacity, building envelope set, marketed for a family compound with 3-car garage, pool and pool house. Neighbors already have substantial new construction. One of the cleanest build-a-compound paths in range.

listings.beach_access: public beach noted; minutes to Long Point Beach / south shore preserve
listings.notes: 19.3 acres with approvals for a six-lot subdivision (one affordable). Each residential lot allows up to 6 bedrooms and an ADU. Surrounded ~75% by conservation. Over the $2M land budget but the only true multi-dwelling family-compound acreage we verified in the 25-minute radius. Could also remain one estate/farm.
